column1: # Package map of the stage-1 move. Columns: old_prefix, class_filter, new_prefix, note.
# Prefixes are relative to dev.caecorthus.sparkdlc (empty = the root package). The longest old_prefix wins;
# a rule with a class_filter (regex on the simple class name) applies only to that exact package and beats
# the plain rule of the same package. A plain rule also covers sub-packages no longer rule names.
# 第一阶段搬迁的包映射。列：old_prefix、class_filter、new_prefix、note。前缀相对 dev.caecorthus.sparkdlc
# （空 = 根包）。最长的 old_prefix 优先；带 class_filter（简单类名正则）的规则只作用于该包本身，并优先于
# 同一包的普通规则。普通规则同时覆盖没有更长规则的子包。
